subject.title: fix(auto-reply): hide recovered failed tool progress

question: Should regular-verbose recovered failure progress be hidden after confirmed visible non-error delivery, while full verbose and terminal/no-success failures remain visible?
rationale: The implementation appears correct and well-proven, but it deliberately changes shared user-visible diagnostic and message-delivery policy.

options.title: Accept buffered recovery policy
options.body: Merge this exact head with regular-verbose recovered failures hidden only after confirmed visible success.

options.title: Retain immediate diagnostics
options.body: Decline or redesign the PR so every failed progress event remains visible regardless of later recovery.

recommendation.title: Accept buffered recovery policy
recommendation.body: Merge this exact head with regular-verbose recovered failures hidden only after confirmed visible success.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the current-main shared progress and final-delivery flow and is the strongest history-backed owner for this policy choice.
